original.statement: Traefik Proxy v2 versions, with v2.11.2 as the last minor, reached end-of-life on 2026-09-07 and are no longer receiving security fixes; migration to v3 is required for continued security support.

decision.reason: The product-relationship family is for a dependency on another product, and its name must be that other product's id. Naming traefik as its own relationship misuses the family. [ev-525d11df6567] only describes Traefik's general version-support policy: the last minor after a new major gets 2 years of support. It does not describe a deprecated dependency or interaction with another product. The source text describes v2 reaching end-of-life, not a deprecated feature that still works, and no subject family in the vocabulary fits the product's own release lifecycle, so no corrected assertion follows.
